try: Let each person see only the leads they work on
how:
1. Side navigation "Settings" › "Lead management"
2. Under "Who sees leads", pick "Only the leads assigned to them"
3. Open the "Studio" tab and find "Who may do what"
expect: The choice stays picked; in "Who may do what", "See leads" reads "Their team’s" for Manager and "Their own" for Designer
in10: Different from 1.0: a studio rule, checked everywhere

try: Switch to Sarah, a designer on James’s team
how:
1. Click the "Demo Studio" block at the bottom of the side navigation
2. In the "View as" menu, click "Sarah"
expect: The menu is tagged "Demo only" and lists the team with roles ("Designer · reports to James"); the block then reads "Viewing as Sarah"

try: Check Sarah sees only her own leads
how:
1. Open "Leads"
2. Read the list and the count on the "All Leads" pill
expect: Only her leads, e.g. Farah Ahmad, Grace Lim, Harpreet Kaur, Kenji Sato (and Sophia Wong if hers); no Gerald Tan or Serena Koh
in10: Different from 1.0: 1.0 hid other leads only on screen

try: Try to hand one of her leads to someone else
how:
1. On Harpreet Kaur’s row, click the person-plus icon ("Assign members") in "Members"
2. Try to tick another member
expect: "Assign Member" opens but nothing can be ticked; it says "Designers keep the leads assigned to them. Ask your manager to reassign."
in10: Different from 1.0: designers could reassign in 1.0

try: Propose a new item for the price book
how:
1. Side navigation "Company" › "Price book" › "New" › "Propose an item"
2. "Item name": Rattan wardrobe door · "Unit": Pieces · "Cost (S$)": 180 · "Markup (S$)": 70 · "Category": Carpentry
3. Click "Propose"
expect: "Rattan wardrobe door proposed — it’s on your quotes now; an Owner or an Admin approves it for the studio"; the item wears a "Proposed" chip
in10: Different from 1.0: 1.0’s pending items were live for everyone

try: Design a quote template and submit it for approval
how:
1. "Company" › "Templates" › "Quotes" › "New" › "Use a ready-made design"
2. Pick "Scope", type Sarah Scope in "Template name", click "Create template"
3. Click "Submit for approval", write a note in "What changed", click "Submit"
expect: "Submitted for approval"; a bar says Sarah submitted it and "Awaiting an Owner or Admin", and the design is locked
in10: Different from 1.0: any role could change templates

try: Revise Harpreet Kaur’s quote and send it for approval
how:
1. Open Harpreet Kaur › "Quotes" and open her quote
2. Click ⋮ "More options" › "Revise — new version", then "Start version …"
3. Click "Send"
expect: The status becomes "Sent for Approval"; a bar says Sarah sent it for approval, "Waiting for an Owner, an Admin or the backup approver"

how:

try: Switch to James and see his team’s leads
expect: His own and his designers’ leads — e.g. Arjun Mehta, Harpreet Kaur (Sarah’s), Aisha Rahman (Michelle’s) — but not Serena Koh or Jonathan Teo

how:

2. See who can be ticked, then close without saving
expect: Only James, Sarah and Michelle can be ticked; every other member is greyed out
